title: A Space's Circle sub-header sits on the page with no card, calmer type, quiet actions and no Circles crumb

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14 (/circles/temple-moon): remove the white card behind the Circle sub-header, soften and clean up the section, and remove the Circles breadcrumb.

detail: Under a Space header (the SCAN-900 in-Space path, .fqm-cl-hero.is-plain) the Circle's band loses its card: no background, border, shadow or radius, and overflow is visible so the Create and QR menus are not clipped. The Circle name drops from h2 display type to the h3 step in the sans; the Active status is a small tag that hugs its words instead of stretching the column; Create stays the one filled button while QR, Edit and Manage become quiet 36px text buttons; the run down to the Feed tabs and the About card tightens. FqCircleShell drops the Circles back link when inSpace. Circles outside a Space and DAWN are unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-b.css','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/circle/circle-shell.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];const i=a.indexOf('SCAN-910');const b=i<0?'':a.slice(i);if(!/\.fqm-cl-hero\.is-plain\{[^}]*background:none;box-shadow:none/.test(b))bad.push('the in-Space Circle band still sits on a card');if(!/\.fqm-cl-hero\.is-plain \.fqm-cl-in \.tag\{align-self:flex-start/.test(b))bad.push('the status pill still stretches');if(!/\.fqm-cl-hero\.is-plain \.fqm-cl-in \.h1\{[^}]*var\(--fq-text-h3\)/.test(b))bad.push('the Circle name is still display size');if(!/\.fqm-cl-hero\.is-plain \.fqm-cl-in \.btn:not\(\.pa\)\{[^}]*background:transparent/.test(b))bad.push('QR, Edit and Manage are still full buttons');if(!/\{!inSpace && \(\s*<Link className=.meta fqm-back/.test(c))bad.push('the Circles crumb still shows under a Space header');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-910: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
